title: REFORM-EVAL: EVALUATING LARGE VISION LANGUAGE MODELS VIA UNIFIED RE-FORMULATION OF TASK-ORIENTED BENCHMARKS

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the choice distribution of models on multiple-choice questions to determine if they exhibit an 'option preference' for specific option letters (e.g., repeatedly selecting 'A' or 'B') when uncertain about the correct answer, regardless of the options' actual content.
